children: Spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $412 million in net outflows on November 6 (U.S. Eastern Time), with BlackRock's IBIT posting the largest outflow at $403 million. According to PANews, citing SoSoValue data, Fidelity's FBTC recorded the largest net inflow, at $42.8 million, bringing its cumulative net inflows to $10.266 billion. IBIT's cumulative net inflows stood at $65.101 billion.

title: Bitcoin ETFs See $412M in Net Outflows, With BlackRock's IBIT Losing $403M
